style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Readable low blue/cyan stone corner with rounded crafted masses and soft light, coherent exact canonical-middle joins at its two true ports, and a clean native turn at logical128/phone32.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A deliberate low corner shelf turns between its actual two registered ports, with broad stone top volumes and softly eased rock edges; a clear layered side mass gives thickness without exceeding the low-shelf envelope.
priorityOutcomes.avoid: Awkward folded faces, collapsed inner turn, black triangular intrusions, disconnected pebbles and a tall wall silhouette.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Bright cyan/blue top planes and cobalt blue sides retain the palette family, with soft broad highlights and dimensional tone; any lavender pebble accents remain subordinate. All views look like the same material under horizontally neutral world light.
priorityOutcomes.avoid: Blown white slabs, plastic wet glare, near-black dead flanks, directional ground shadows and noise-like detail.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Large purposeful stone divisions, gentle plane changes and optional sparse pebble/vein accents survive at logical cell128 and phone cell32. Details taper or stop before connector zones so the turn belongs to one continuous shelf family.
priorityOutcomes.avoid: Uniform scratch bars, repeated bead rows, busy microcracks and decoration whose primary effect is join disruption.

hardConstraints: Measured finite source footprint, ground contacts and full geometry bounds; root/camera/projection/registration and static timing preserved.
Every actual turned port must match the exact approved shelf-middle endpoint geometry, normals, material/albedo field under the correct transform.
All four native facings and independent native/runtime family assemblies must show continuous visible joins without repair, overlap, per-view fit or runtime helper changes.
No local visible cracks, alpha halos, black patches, clipping, seams or unwanted cast shadows on light/gray/dark backgrounds.

qualityCriteria.normalEvaluation: Canonical normal means the normalized post-interpolation normal actually used in the native shader. An equivalent native attribute/shader implementation is allowed; geometric/custom-normal storage differences are separately reported, never mislabeled or used to waive visible defects.
